title: LTA — History of tennis
scope: Official LTA account of British lawn-tennis history, Wimbledon from 1877 and the LTA foundation in 1888.
limitations: Historical milestones support tradition and institutional continuity, not annual participation or coaching quality. Earth code GBR is the United Kingdom, while LTA/Great Britain tennis remit is not a perfect political-territory match (notably Northern Ireland, and LTA inclusion of Channel Islands/Isle of Man); this source is therefore an explicit association-remit proxy rather than a literal UK census.
